'''Sedi Fisk's desert manor''' was a manor located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] owned by [[Sedi Fisk]]. The manor was protected by high [[Stone/Legends|stone]] walls with smaller residences situated all around the manor, forming a little community. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the manor and surrounding dwellings were abandoned and in ruins. [[Womp rat/Legends|Womp rats]] had taken to living in the remains of the community, and attacked a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s who traveled to the area during the [[Escape from Tatooine|hunt]] for [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]].<ref name="Manhunt" />
